Usage: mycli build [OPTIONS] SRC

  Build the project.

Options:
  -o, --output PATH           Where to write results.  [default: dist]
  --format [json|yaml|text]   Output format.
  --color / --no-color        Colorize output.
  -j, --jobs INTEGER          Parallel jobs.  [required]
  --help                      Show this message and exit.
